topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range introduces beam squint, increasing scan losses and altering antenna gain, which reduces signal quality and capacity for edge-of-coverage users. This affects link budget calculations, necessitating adaptive bandwidth management to maintain QoS guarantees.
reference_context: Phased array antennas exhibit scan losses and beam squint, impacting link budget calculations and QoS guarantees.
